preconditions.description: The number of intersections n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two intersections, both of which are numbered between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of road pairs in the input matches the specified number of roads m.

preconditions.expression: len(set((u, v) for u, v in roads)) == m
preconditions.description: No two roads connect the same pair of intersections.

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: No road connects an intersection to itself.

postconditions.description: The output starts with either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') == (len(routes) == 3 and all(len(route) >= 2 for route in routes) and all(route[0] == route[-1] for route in routes) and len(set.intersection(*[set(route) for route in routes])) == 2 and len(set.union(*[set(route) for route in routes])) > 2 and all(len(set(zip(route, route[1:]))) == len(route) - 1 for route in routes) and all(len(set(zip(route, route[1:])) & set(zip(route[::-1], route[::-1][1:]))) == 0 for route in routes))
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'YES', there are exactly three routes, each starting and ending at the same intersection, with no common junctions or roads except the start and finish, and no repeated intersections or roads in any route.
If the output starts with 'NO', no routes are provided.
